name: Announcer
description: Shows a message on every player's client — it fades, so lasting facts belong on a board. Works with: Game Flow.

drivenBy.rule: This item shows nothing by itself — the server sends a line, and every player's client shows it for a few seconds.
drivenBy.next: Press New script below and write that line inside the isServer() block it comes with — a third argument, the player, shows it on that one player's client only.

changelog.notes: Initial release: server code anywhere in the scene calls game.broadcast('announce', { text }) and every player's client shows the line for a few seconds.
The placed item's Script card now shows the broadcast line that makes it speak, under its hold seconds and font size.
